changes.what: Replaced hitscan botShoot (traceShot) with a travelling soak projectile via Projectiles.spawn (team-coloured blob, speed 46, gravity 3, dmg 20, owner=bot.netId). Removed WEAPON/traceShot import.
changes.why: Director directive #1: unify bot combat into the same dodgeable soak model the player uses, so vs-bot and vs-friend PvP are identical.

changes.what: Deleted orphaned hitscan exports (WEAPON, raySphere, traceShot, Magazine, buildViewModel); kept only applySpread.
changes.why: Director directive #1 acceptance (c): no code path references the ghost carbine anymore.

changes.what: Added projectiles to bot brain ctx; _onProjectileHit now reports bot-owned projectile hits via _request; created this.stamina in _initLoadout (leafblade no longer gets a soak Charge); drain stamina on sprint; gate saber swing on stamina; refill stamina in the refill effect; exposed stamina in hud(); guarded charges loops with ?..
changes.why: Director directives #1, #2, #3: one combat world, two resources, items serve both families.

changes.what: Added windLock state + wind() method; startSwing() refuses while winded; update() flickers the blade when winded.
changes.why: Director directive #2: a swing tried with no stamina whiffs and telegraphs instead of silently failing.

changes.what: Added STAMINA config + Stamina class (max 100, swingCost 34, sprintDrain 22/s, regen 30/s, swingLock 0.42s).
changes.why: Director directive #2: the saber's own distinct resource, shared with sprint.

changes.what: Renamed ammo -> surge (icon ⚡, 'Refill your soak-charge and stamina'), kept effect {refill:true}.
changes.why: Director directive #3: dead pickup now serves BOTH weapon families.

changes.what: Added a dedicated STAMINA HUD bar (distinct green); renamed orphaned .ammo CSS to .surge; minor comment fix.
changes.why: Director directive #2 acceptance (b): stamina must be visibly its own bar; kill 'ammo' string.

directives_done: 1 - unify bot combat into the dodgeable soak projectile model (hitscan removed)
2 - saber now uses a distinct Stamina resource shared with sprint; winded whiff when empty
3 - ammo crate repurposed to surge, refilling both soak-charge and stamina; zero ammo refs left
